targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS "time", AVG(avg_voltage) AS "avg_voltage" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Voltage Range Across Homes (min/avg/max of hourly averages)

targets.rawSql: SELECT window_start AS "time", MIN(avg_voltage) AS "min_v", AVG(avg_voltage) AS "avg_v", MAX(avg_voltage) AS "max_v" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT window_start AS "time", AVG(avg_current) AS "avg_current" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT window_start AS "time", COUNT(DISTINCT home_id) AS "homes" FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Worst Power Factor Homes (avg_pf) in Time Range

targets.rawSql: SELECT home_id, AVG(avg_pf) AS avg_pf FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Lowest Sample Volume Homes (possible missing data)

targets.rawSql: SELECT home_id, SUM(samples) AS samples FROM paimon.iot.sensor_data_hourly WHERE $__timeFilter(window_start) AND dt BETWEEN date_format(from_unixtime(${__from:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') AND date_format(from_unixtime(${__to:date:seconds}), '%Y-%m-%d') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
